text: opus5-13 start: canvas tool + nesting + rename. Reading ground truth: board-preview node type, markdown sidecar path helpers, registry/build pipeline.

Ground truth mapped. mountCosmoboard(host) already mounts a whole board per [data-board-app] element and arbitrates keys via _mountedBoardCount, so a live nested board is reachable without an iframe. board-preview fetches any .canvas path and draws a minimap. Markdown sidecars already prove the rename model: retitling a note never renames its file on disk, so nothing to rewrite. Leaning that way for canvas.

Separate live bug found while mapping the ground truth: GET /api/list-markdown returns 500 'readdir is not defined'. scripts/preview-server.mjs uses readdir at line 687 but never imports it, so the markdown-db node has been listing nothing. One-word import fix, folded into my patch.

Working end to end in a mirrored repo on 4185. Canvas tool writes a real .canvas sidecar with a canvasId; the node opens as a live nested board (mountCosmoboard, no iframe) that saves back to that file; the parent minimap then reads 1 item. Renaming the title keeps the file name. Renaming the FILE on disk and reloading: the node heals itself by canvasId via a new /api/list-canvas and still renders the child's node. Markdown ![[x.canvas]] embeds render and are editable back to raw text.

Done. patch.json (21 anchored hunks, braindump.js + preview-server.mjs) and notes.md are in .tmp/scratch/opus5-13/. Rename decision: stable canvasId plus display name, argued against a 17-row reference inventory; a rewriter cannot be complete because board-preview refs and markdown file paths live in .canvas data and per-board localStorage. tests/board/canvas-tool-and-rename.test.mjs passes with the patch, fails at 'null !== Canvas' without it. Two side bugs fixed: list-markdown 500 (readdir never imported), and paste duplicating a node per mounted board. Heads up: tests/board/cosmoboard-legacy-render-fields.test.mjs binds port 4185, the port I was given. My 4185 server is stopped.
